Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange advanced by 1.3% to reach $12,636.50 per metric ton by 0200 GMT, bouncing back from a drop that represented its largest single-day decline since April 2025.

Despite the upward tick in London, copper contracts on the Shanghai Futures Exchange continued to slide, moving down 4.1% to 95,740 yuan, or approximately $14,358.99, per ton. Market experts described the London movement as a relief rather than a definitive market shift, noting that the preceding sharp drop was influenced by a robust US dollar and mounting uncertainty regarding the speed of artificial intelligence data-center construction.

Broader macroeconomic factors played a significant role in market movements, with the US dollar remaining near a 19-month peak following Federal Reserve meeting minutes and hawkish remarks hinting at potential additional interest rate hikes. A strengthening dollar increases the cost of dollar-priced metals for buyers using other currencies, whereas elevated interest rates often depress growth-sensitive industrial commodities like copper by dampening overall economic activity.

Meanwhile, mixed results were observed across other industrial metals on the London Metal Exchange, where aluminium gained 1.2%, zinc rose 1.5%, lead edged up 0.1%, tin increased by 0.6%, and nickel remained unchanged. Conversely, Shanghai metals mostly fell, with aluminium dropping 1.3%, zinc decreasing 2.7%, lead losing 0.3%, nickel slipping 3%, and tin dipping 2.1%. Additionally, figures released by the International Lead and Zinc Study Group indicated that worldwide lead and zinc markets transitioned into a deficit during the month of September.

stories.title: Pakistan Urges UN to Stop India Weaponizing Shared Water Resources
stories.summary:
Pakistan has strongly criticized India's unilateral decision to place the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance, warning that using shared water resources for political pressure threatens regional peace and endangers millions of lives. Speaking at a United Nations Security Council meeting in New York, Pakistan's Deputy Permanent Representative, Ambassador Usman Jadoon, stated that India's actions risk the livelihoods and well-being of more than 240 million citizens by attempting to cut off water flows and weaponize transboundary resources.

Ambassador Jadoon highlighted that the Permanent Court of Arbitration issued an award on August 31, 2026, confirming that the 1960 treaty—brokered by the World Bank—remains fully in force and binds India to its obligations. He emphasized that shared natural resources must not be exploited as instruments of coercion or state pressure, noting that the agreement lacks any provisions allowing either party to unilaterally suspend or terminate its terms. The historical treaty allocates the eastern rivers of Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej to India, while the western rivers of Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab are largely designated for Pakistan.

The diplomatic tensions follow New Delhi's April 2025 move to pause the treaty after 26 people were killed in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir, an attack New Delhi blamed on Islamabad despite denials from Pakistan. During the Arria-formula meeting focused on natural resources and conflict prevention, Jadoon stressed that regional stability relies on peaceful dispute resolution and mutual cooperation. He invoked UN Security Council Resolution 2788, urging both nations to utilize peaceful mechanisms under Article 33 of the UN Charter to respect international law and agreed arrangements.

stories.title: Saudi Aramco Issues Tender to Sell Eleven Fuel Oil Cargoes
stories.summary:
Saudi Aramco has released a new commercial tender aimed at selling a batch of high-sulphur fuel oil cargoes slated for loading throughout late November and December. Industry sources reported the development on Thursday, highlighting the state-backed energy firm's ongoing export activities.

The latest offering comprises a total of 11 high-sulphur fuel oil cargoes initiated through a tender issued late Wednesday. These shipments are divided between two key operational locations, with seven designated for loading from the Ras Tanura facility and four scheduled for loading from Jubail.

Prospective buyers and market participants must submit their proposals before the tender officially closes on November 23. This offering follows routine trading procedures utilized by the company to market its petroleum products to international buyers.

The disposition of these high-sulphur fuel oil cargoes provides insight into regional supply availability from Saudi Arabia's major refining and export hubs as the market transitions toward the final weeks of the calendar year.

stories.title: Federal Board of Revenue Establishes Digital Faceless Tax Appeals System
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue in Islamabad has formally launched a new mechanism designed to manage tax appeals through a completely faceless and digital system. Under the implemented procedure, all qualifying appeals will be processed electronically via a centralized framework, replacing traditional in-person hearings with digital platforms.

Taxpayers must submit their appeals through the IRIS portal, where a computerized allocation system will automatically assign cases to commissioners. To safeguard impartiality, the identity of the presiding commissioner will stay strictly confidential, ensuring that neither the appellant nor the relevant department learns the officer's name, designation, or signature.

Hearings will be conducted exclusively via video conferencing, incorporating strict anonymity measures where the commissioner's face remains hidden and their voice is altered. Furthermore, all notices, written replies, and supporting documentation must be uploaded digitally, and officers who handled the original audit or assessment are barred from hearing appeals against their own decisions.

Decisions rendered under this framework will feature unique digital identification numbers, and applications for stay orders will similarly be processed online within designated timeframes. While technical system failures may grant reasonable extensions, previously pending appeals will stay with their current commissioners unless the FBR Board mandates a transfer. Separately, the Punjab government launched an online portal enabling women to divide family land and claim legal rights using mobile phones.

stories.title: خالد مقبول صدیقی کا بلاول بھٹو کے بیان پر شدید ردعمل اور نوٹس لینے کا مطالبہ
stories.summary: متحدہ قومی موومنٹ پاکستان کے رہنما خالد مقبول صدیقی نے کراچی میں پریس کانفرنس کرتے ہوئے چیئرمین پیپلز پارٹی بلاول بھٹو زرداری کے بیان کو پورے پاکستان کے لیے دھمکی قرار دیا اور عدالتوں سمیت امن و امان کے ذمے داروں سے اس کا فوری نوٹس لینے کا مطالبہ کیا۔ انہوں نے بلاول بھٹو پر نسل پرستی کا الزام لگاتے ہوئے سوال کیا کہ سندھ کے شہری علاقوں میں خونریزی کون کرائے گا اور کیا عزیر بلوچ سے خونریزی کرانی ہے۔ خالد مقبول صدیقی کا کہنا تھا کہ ایم کیو ایم نے کبھی کراچی یا مہاجر صوبے کی بات نہیں کی بلکہ پورے ملک میں آبادی کے لحاظ سے صوبے بننے کی بات کی ہے، اور اگر ملک میں کہیں صوبوں کا سب سے مضبوط مقدمہ ہے تو وہ سندھ کے شہری علاقوں کا ہے۔ انہوں نے دعویٰ کیا کہ سندھ کی 65 فیصد آبادی نئے صوبے بننے کا فیصلہ کر چکی ہے اور پیپلز پارٹی مصنوعی اکثریت کی بنیاد پر حکومت کر رہی ہے۔ ایم کیو ایم رہنما نے خبردار کیا کہ پاکستان کو کسی بھی لسانی تفریق کا شکار نہیں ہونے دیا جائے گا اور ان کے شہروں کو دھمکیاں دینے والے ہوش کے ناخن لیں۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ سندھ کے شہری علاقوں نے صوبوں کے حوالے سے جو بات کی تھی، آج وہی بحث پورے ملک میں کی جا رہی ہے اور اس معاملے کو ایوانوں میں بھی اٹھایا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: پیپلز پارٹی نے ہمیشہ مفادات کی سیاست کی، منعم ظفر
stories.summary:
جماعت اسلامی کراچی کے امیر منعم ظفر نے ایک پریس کانفرنس کے دوران پیپلز پارٹی پر شدید تنقید کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اس جماعت نے ہر دور میں اپنے مفادات کے لیے جمہوریت کا سودا کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ پیپلز پارٹی نے گذشتہ 18 سالوں کے دوران سندھ کو مکمل طور پر تباہی کے دہانے پر لا کھڑا کیا ہے۔

منعم ظفر کا کہنا تھا کہ پیپلز پارٹی ہمیشہ سے اسٹیبلشمنٹ کے ساتھ ہونے والی لڑائیوں کی سب سے بڑی مستفید رہی ہے اور اس کی پوری تاریخ اقتدار کی ہوس اور جمہوریت دشمنی سے بھری پڑی ہے۔ انہوں نے 1970ء کے انتخابات کا حوالہ دیتے ہوئے بتایا کہ اس وقت عوامی لیگ کو 160 اور پیپلز پارٹی کو 81 نشستیں ملی تھیں، اور اس دور میں اسمبلی اجلاس میں جانے والوں کی ٹانگیں توڑنے کی دھمکیاں دی گئی تھیں۔

امیر جماعت اسلامی کراچی نے مزید کہا کہ موجودہ صورتحال میں طلباء اور اساتذہ سمیت معاشرے کے ہر طبقے سے تعلق رکھنے والے افراد دھرنے میں بھرپور شرکت کر رہے ہیں۔ ان کا یہ بھی کہنا تھا کہ اس طرح کے سیاسی رویے اور ماضی کے فیصلے ملک کے جمہوری ڈھانچے اور عوام کے حقوق پر ایک بڑا سوالیہ نشان ہیں۔

یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب ملک بھر میں سیاسی گرما گرمی عروج پر ہے اور مختلف سیاسی جماعتیں ایک دوسرے پر شدید الزامات عائد کر رہی ہیں۔ اس پریس کانفرنس میں کراچی کے سیاسی مسائل اور عوام کو درپیش مشکلات پر بھی تفصیلی گفتگو کی گئی، جس سے شہر کی موجودہ سیاسی صورتحال مزید واضح ہوتی ہے۔

stories.title: بلاول بھٹو کا محسن نقوی کے صوبوں کی تقسیم کے بیان پر طنز
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے ایک انٹرویو کے دوران وفاقی وزیر داخلہ اور چیئرمین پاکستان کرکٹ بورڈ محسن نقوی پر سخت تنقید کی ہے۔ انہوں نے سوال اٹھایا کہ اگر صوبے کو تقسیم کیا جانا ہے تو کیا اس معاملے پر بات کرنے کا حق صرف چیئرمین پی سی بی کے پاس ہی محفوظ ہے۔ بلاول بھٹو کا کہنا تھا کہ انہیں بھی اس موضوع پر بحث کرنے کا اتنا ہی حق حاصل ہے جتنا اسے شروع کرنے والے کو حاصل ہے۔

انہوں نے اپنے گزشتہ روز دیے گئے اس بیان کی بھی وضاحت پیش کی جس میں انہوں نے خبردار کیا تھا کہ سندھ کی زبردستی تقسیم کی صورت میں کراچی کی سڑکوں پر خون بہے گا۔ پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین نے واضح کیا کہ ان کے اس جملے کو دھمکی نہ سمجھا جائے بلکہ یہ ایک خطرے کی گھنٹی تھی کہ زبردستی کی کوشش سے صوبے میں ایسی آگ لگ سکتی ہے جسے بجھانا انتہائی مشکل ہوگا۔ یاد رہے کہ محسن نقوی حالیہ مہینوں میں نئے صوبوں کے قیام اور اس ضمن میں ریفرنڈم کرانے کی تجاویز پیش کرتے رہے ہیں۔

بلاول بھٹو نے انٹرویو میں مزید کہا کہ انہوں نے نہ تو نظام کے بیٹھ جانے یعنی کولیپس کی بحث چھیڑی اور نہ ہی کسی غیر آئینی ریفرنڈم کے ذریعے صوبوں کو تقسیم کرنے کی بات کی۔ ان کا موقف تھا کہ نظام میں کسی بھی قسم کی تبدیلی کے فیصلوں کے اندر تمام تر سیاسی قوتوں اور دیگر متعلقہ اسٹیک ہولڈرز کی شمولیت کو یقینی بنانا انتہائی ضروری ہے۔

واضح رہے کہ یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب ملک میں مختلف سیاسی امور اور انتظامی ڈھانچے پر بحث جاری ہے۔ بلاول بھٹو نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں کہا کہ وہ چپ چاپ گھر نہیں بیٹھ سکتے جبکہ دوسرے لوگ صوبوں کی تقسیم جیسے حساس معاملات پر اپنی رائے کا اظہار کر رہے ہوں۔

stories.title: PML-N Leader Khurram Dastgir Criticizes Bilawal Bhutto Over Threatening Remarks
stories.summary:
Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) senior leader and former federal minister Engineer Khurram Dastgir Khan criticized Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari for issuing threats of violence. Speaking to the press, Dastgir stated that while Bilawal was entitled to share his perspective, resorting to aggressive warnings was inappropriate, especially as political discussions regarding the formation of new provinces were only beginning. He urged all political factions to maintain restraint and avoid hostile reactions to differing viewpoints.

Dastgir pointed out that the PPP has held power in Sindh for the past 18 years and must bear accountability for the province's law and order. Comparing historical security conditions, he noted that targeted killings were widespread in Karachi back in 2008 before the PML-N administration led by former prime minister Nawaz Sharif intervened to restore stability in 2013. He advised political entities to allow adequate time for dialogue rather than rushing into direct confrontations.

Addressing the ongoing proposals for creating new administrative divisions, Dastgir suggested that a comprehensive white paper be drafted to establish a clear justification for any territorial changes. He argued that current discussions have failed to adequately demonstrate how dividing provinces would practically benefit the country. To address this, he recommended the formation of a provincial restructuring commission featuring representatives from various political parties to properly evaluate administrative unit sizes for effective governance.

Dastgir stressed that decisions regarding new provinces should be based on rational planning rather than emotional claims about territory belonging exclusively to specific groups. He also mentioned that the prime minister intends to host political consultations with various parties in the coming week.

stories.title: Xi and Trump Meet in Shenzhen Ahead of Trilateral With Putin
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and United States President Donald Trump held bilateral talks in Shenzhen on Thursday ahead of a scheduled trilateral summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum, Xi remarked to Trump that Beijing-Washington relations remained generally stable and improved. The leaders' discussions were expected to cover trade ties, artificial intelligence rules, and broader strategic stability, set against the backdrop of ongoing global conflicts including the war in Ukraine and the conflict in Iran.

Prior to their joint session with Xi, Trump and Putin held a separate bilateral meeting where Trump referred to his Russian counterpart as a friend and noted their long-standing relationship. The historic three-way gathering between Xi, Trump, and Putin aims to address international peace and security, though critics have raised concerns that the optics might project a division of the globe into spheres of influence. While Washington initially indicated that the war in Ukraine would not be a primary focus, both US and Kremlin officials acknowledged that avoiding the subject would be difficult as the conflict nears its five-year mark.

The discussions also touched upon nuclear disarmament and global security frameworks, following the expiration of a major US-Russia atomic arms treaty in February. Trump highlighted the existing nuclear arsenals of the US and Russia alongside China's smaller stockpile. Meanwhile, Beijing welcomed Trump with elaborate red-carpet ceremonies at the airport, breaking traditional diplomatic protocols in a move praised by the US president as a sign of mutual respect.

The APEC summit brought together numerous international figures, including leaders from Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia, and Mexico. The gathering's primary events featured leaders posing for a traditional group photograph while wearing commemorative scarves, alongside official dialogues centered on reducing barriers to international trade and investment.

stories.title: China's Yuan Holds Steady as Investors Await US-China Talks in Shenzhen
stories.summary:
China’s yuan remained stable during Thursday morning trading in Shanghai, holding around 6.6667 per dollar despite a robust global currency market and a strengthening US dollar index. Investors closely watched developments in Shenzhen, where Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit ahead of a planned meeting with US President Donald Trump and Russian leader Vladimir Putin. Nanhua Futures noted that discussions between American and Chinese officials would likely center on tariffs, trade, and export controls on tech and rare-earth materials, noting that an extension of trade truces or eased restrictions could benefit yuan-denominated assets.

The broader foreign exchange market saw the dollar index climb to its highest level since April 2025, driven by expectations of US interest rate hikes following recent Federal Reserve meeting minutes and comments from International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva urging monetary tightening. Unlike other nations grappling with inflation, China's economy has faced domestic struggles including weak consumption and an ongoing property crisis.

Despite these domestic headwinds, the yuan has rallied nearly five percent throughout the year. UBS Securities chief China economist Yu Song projects that the People's Bank of China will lower reserve requirements and cut policy rates next year to stimulate growth. Song anticipates the currency will eventually strengthen to 6.25 per dollar by late 2027, bolstered by a significant current account surplus and diminishing capital outflow pressures, with the central bank allowing market forces to dictate the pace.

stories.title: US President Trump Rejects Globalist AI Regulation Ahead of Xi Meeting
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump stated on Thursday that his administration completely rejects any form of international or globalist regulation over artificial intelligence, referring to the technology as "super intelligence." Speaking at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting in Shenzhen, Trump emphasized the need to carefully manage the technology's risks while warning that broad international governance would hinder American competitiveness against China.

Trump’s remarks preceded a scheduled meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, where artificial intelligence governance and rapid technological shifts were expected to be major agenda items. Both nations face shared technological and security risks, ranging from critical infrastructure hacking and bioweapon creation to autonomous AI agents carrying out unauthorized real-time tasks. Additional flashpoints for the two leading artificial intelligence powers include military applications and mass surveillance, alongside discussions regarding a newly established urgent communication channel for artificial intelligence incidents agreed upon in September.

The bilateral talks also occur against the backdrop of differing international views on artificial intelligence oversight. While Xi Jinping previously advocated for strict human control, technological monitoring, and increased regulations at a summer gathering, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney described the complete absence of global artificial intelligence frameworks as an enormous risk requiring immediate international attention. Meanwhile, separate domestic political friction surfaced as Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz leader Engineer Khurram Dastgir Khan publicly criticized Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari for issuing threats of violence.

stories.title: Alcaraz Remains Calm Despite Hamstring Scare at ATP Finals in Turin
stories.summary:
Spanish tennis star Carlos Alcaraz admitted he is still managing a hamstring injury sustained during his recent victory over Daniil Medvedev at the ATP Finals in Turin. The world No. 3 required a medical timeout in the middle of the match to have his left thigh strapped before securing a 6-2, 6-4 win to reach the tournament semifinals.

Alcaraz explained that despite feeling discomfort in his leg, he managed to stay focused by altering his tactics and avoiding overly aggressive movement. The 23-year-old is scheduled to play his final round-robin match against the already eliminated Flavio Cobolli, using the intervening days for recovery and consultation with his medical team and coaching staff.

Reflecting on his physical setbacks, Alcaraz credited a nearly five-month absence due to a wrist injury with completely shifting his mental approach to the sport. Having returned to competition at the late August US Open and subsequently capturing titles in Tokyo, Vienna, and Paris, the seven-time Grand Slam champion noted that the lengthy layoff taught him to appreciate competing while healthy, allowing him to approach on-court challenges with greater calm, maturity, and perspective.

stories.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Intercepts Houthi Missiles Aimed at Riyadh and South
stories.summary:
A loud explosion echoed through Riyadh on Thursday as the Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting a missile threat directed by Yemen’s Houthi movement toward the Saudi capital. Initial assessments from the coalition indicated that falling debris caused material damage, though evaluations of the full impact were ongoing. Shortly after the incident, Saudi aircraft launched retaliatory airstrikes targeting the Houthi-controlled Yemeni capital of Sanaa, according to the Houthi-run Saba news agency. The coalition also confirmed the destruction of a cruise missile fired toward Saudi Arabia's southern border region.

The missile barrage occurred concurrently with a meeting in Riyadh between Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper, where the two officials reviewed regional developments and bilateral military relations. The Saudi Civil Defense agency briefly issued a public warning regarding potential dangers in the capital before declaring the area safe.

Tensions have escalated sharply between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthi group following Houthi advances near Yemen's strategic Red Sea coast and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which serves as a vital global shipping lane. These developments have effectively shattered the 2022 United Nations-brokered truce that had previously curbed hostilities between the coalition supporting Yemen's internationally recognized government and the Houthi movement, which controls the country's most populous regions. Amid a broader regional conflict involving Iran, the Houthis have repeatedly targeted Saudi infrastructure, including airports, oil facilities, and properties belonging to Saudi Aramco.

stories.title: Islam Projected to Surpass Christianity as World's Largest Religion by 2035
stories.summary:
Islam is on course to surpass Christianity as the largest religion globally by the middle of the next decade, according to projections released on Wednesday by the Pew Research Centre. While Christianity has historically maintained the top position for centuries, rapid growth in the global Muslim population is expected to push numbers to 2.57 billion by 2035, narrowly exceeding the projected Christian tally of 2.52 billion for that year.

By 2070, current trends indicate that Muslims will outnumber Christians globally 3.6 billion to 3 billion, representing 37 percent of the total global population compared to 26 percent in 2020. During the same period, Christianity is anticipated to remain stable at around 29 percent. Furthermore, Pakistan is projected to climb from the second-largest Muslim population to the world's largest, with its numbers doubling from 227 million in 2020 to 461 million by 2070.

The primary driver behind this demographic shift is higher fertility rates in Muslim regions, which averaged 3.1 children per woman between 2020 and 2025, compared to 2.5 children per Christian woman. In contrast, all other religious categories combined averaged 1.6 children per woman, falling below the replacement level of 2.1. Religious switching will also have a minor impact; while both major faiths will lose more adherents than they gain through switching, Islam is expected to lose far fewer followers—8 million compared to 105 million for Christianity between 2020 and 202070.

Globally, the total population is forecast to grow by 29 percent between 2020 and 2070, with Islam and Christianity being the only two groups expected to match or exceed this pace, expanding by 80 percent and 30 percent respectively. Conversely, other groups such as Hindus, Buddhists, and Jews are expected to experience smaller shares or declines. Additionally, religiously unaffiliated individuals will see a sharp drop as a proportion of the world total, decreasing from 24 percent in 2020 to 17 percent by 2070, largely driven by demographic declines in China.

stories.title: IMF Official Urges Pakistan to Accelerate Economic Reforms and Boost Exports
stories.summary:
Mahir Binici, the Resident Representative of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in Pakistan, has emphasized the critical need for accelerated structural economic reforms, increased investments, and a strengthened export sector to secure sustainable economic growth. Speaking at a seminar hosted by a research institution, Binici pointed out that Pakistan's investment rates have stayed below desired levels, signaling a pressing requirement to attract both domestic and foreign capital.

Binici highlighted that a productive and stable agricultural sector is vital for enhancing export performance. He also stressed the necessity of upgrading workforce skills and improving labor standards to elevate overall economic productivity and competitiveness. To successfully expand exports, he noted that Pakistan must actively explore new international markets. Additionally, the IMF representative called for enhanced coordination between federal and provincial authorities to improve tax collection efficiency and raise national revenues.

Addressing broader economic hurdles, Binici explained that climbing international oil prices have negatively impacted growth, while supply chain disruptions have complicated efforts to manage inflation. He pointed out that the national economy faces heavy pressure due to an over-reliance on imported energy, creating stability concerns. Structural reforms must be expedited, he added, noting that poor governance within state-owned corporations continues to drive financial losses and expand deficits.

Finally, Binici underscored the importance of job creation by fostering a more accessible and favorable business environment. He advocated for appropriate regulatory measures to guarantee a level playing field for all enterprises, thereby encouraging robust economic activity and fair competition across the country.

stories.title: Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir Briefed on Counterterrorism Operations in Turbat
stories.summary:
Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir visited Turbat, Balochistan, where he received a comprehensive briefing on counterterrorism operations, according to a press release issued by the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) on Thursday. During the visit, CDF Munir was briefed on the prevailing security environment, operational preparedness, and ongoing efforts against externally sponsored terrorism. He was also updated on the progress of socioeconomic development initiatives across Balochistan.

Interacting directly with deployed troops, CDF Munir praised their high state of operational readiness, professionalism, and determination to defend the country under challenging conditions. He also laid a floral wreath at the Shuhada Monument and reaffirmed the military's dedication to supporting the local population in their pursuit of peace, stability, and sustainable development. Upon arriving in Turbat, the army chief was officially welcomed by the Corps Commander Balochistan.

This visit follows a series of recent security assessments and operations across Pakistan. Earlier this month, Munir visited the Special Services Group headquarters in Tarbela to emphasize indigenous capability and training. Last month, he reviewed border management and counterterrorism measures at the Peshawar Corps Headquarters. Meanwhile, the ISPR reported that security forces eliminated 22 terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa earlier in the week during intelligence-based operations in South Waziristan, Bannu, and Tank.

Pakistan has experienced a notable increase in militant violence since late 2022, when the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan ended its ceasefire. Despite recent fluctuations in attack frequencies across regions like Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, the military's relentless counterterrorism campaign under the 'Azm-e-Istehkam' vision continues at full pace to eradicate foreign-backed terrorism.

stories.title: Farooq Sattar Calls for State Action Over Bilawal Bhutto Zardari's Remarks
stories.summary:
Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) leader and MNA Dr Farooq Sattar has urged state institutions and the federal government to formally investigate recent remarks made by Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari. Speaking to the media in Karachi on Thursday, Sattar characterized Bilawal's statements as hate speech and called for an inquiry into what he alleged was an underlying nexus between the Sindh provincial government and criminal elements.

Sattar's comments came in direct response to Bilawal's warning that any forced division of Sindh against the will of its people would result in bloodshed and violence on the streets of Karachi. Sattar argued that such language strayed from the political legacy of Bilawal's ancestors, Zulfikar Ali Bhutto and Benazir Bhutto, and emphasized that the PPP chairman had specifically spoken about bloodshed rather than merely expressing general concerns.

The MQM-P leader also criticized the provincial government for failing to de-escalate tensions surrounding planned political demonstrations. Both MQM-P and a Sindh national party have scheduled separate rallies in Karachi for November 29—one advocating for new provinces and the other protesting the proposal. Sattar questioned why the Sindh administration had not engaged with both groups earlier to schedule the events on separate dates to avoid potential confrontation, arguing that allowing simultaneous rallies raised serious security concerns.

Furthermore, Sattar took aim at the PPP's 18-year governance in the province, alleging that the administration has benefited from the 18th Constitutional Amendment while failing to resolve fundamental governance problems. He stated that MQM-P leadership would ultimately decide whether to proceed with their scheduled November 29 demonstration in light of the rising local tensions.

stories.title: WAPDA Increases KAPCO Stake Following Supreme Court Ruling
stories.summary:
The Water and Power Development Authority has raised its direct shareholding in the Kot Addu Power Company to 45.75 percent, moving up from 40.26 percent. This change occurred after shares associated with the Benazir Employees Stock Option Scheme were reverted and transferred back to the authority.

KAPCO formally communicated this corporate update via a filing submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Thursday. According to the disclosure, over 48 million ordinary shares previously managed by the KAPCO Employees Empowerment Trust under BESOS were transferred to WAPDA on November 18, 2026, without any cost. Following this transaction, WAPDA's total holdings in the enterprise reached 402,563,562 shares.

The transfer was executed in compliance with a verdict issued by the Supreme Court of Pakistan regarding legal challenges tied to BESOS. The initiative was initially established during the tenure of the Pakistan People’s Party administration under President Asif Ali Zardari to distribute complimentary shares to personnel of state-owned entities.

However, the Supreme Court ruled on October 22, 2022, that the scheme was unconstitutional and violated Article 154 of the country's constitution. The judicial decision mandated that all equities held via employee trusts under the program be returned to the government, resulting in the termination of those trusts.

KAPCO was established as a public limited company in Pakistan on April 25, 1996, having been constructed by WAPDA across five distinct phases in the Muzaffargarh district of Punjab between 1985 and 1996. The utility was subsequently privatized through competitive international bidding in June 1996, leading to various shifts in ownership and its eventual listing on the stock exchange in February 2005.

stories.title: Indian Government Bonds Rise Slightly Amid Global and Domestic Cues
stories.summary:
Indian government bonds experienced marginal gains during early trading sessions on Thursday, recovering slightly from a minor sell-off observed during the previous session. Consistent foreign acquisitions served as a supportive foundation for local bond pricing.

At 10 a.m. Indian Standard Time, the yield on the benchmark 6.94 percent 2036 bond stood at 7.2768 percent, shifting downward from its previous close of 7.2858 percent on Wednesday. Market participants at state-run financial institutions noted that domestic factors remain scarce, leaving local bond trajectories primarily at the mercy of movements in crude oil markets and United States Treasuries.

Yields on US Treasuries stabilized following a significant upward movement the week prior, indicating that financial markets are beginning to adjust to prospects of tighter monetary policies. The 10-year Treasury yield remained under 5.10 percent, even though minutes released from the Federal Reserve's latest policy meeting revealed that agreement on maintaining steady interest rates was not unanimous among officials.

Meanwhile, crude oil values held relatively steady amid growing expectations that global output will outpace consumption throughout the current quarter. Nonetheless, analysts caution that the market remains vulnerable to geopolitical shifts affecting tanker routes through the Strait of Hormuz, where any prolonged interruptions could rapidly restrict international supplies.

For India, a major consumer of imported energy, oil price fluctuations pose a notable macroeconomic vulnerability that can strain the current account balance, the national currency, and domestic inflation metrics. Anticipation is also building within Indian financial circles for a potential interest rate increase by the Reserve Bank of India in early December, following retail inflation figures exceeding the central bank's upper threshold of six percent for the first time in two years.

stories.title: US President Trump and Russian President Putin Meet in China
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump held a bilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday in Shenzhen, China, coinciding with the gathering for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

The encounter brought together the two leaders to discuss their longstanding diplomatic ties. During the talks, President Trump highlighted the duration of their relationship and expressed optimism regarding future cooperation.

Addressing his Russian counterpart, Trump remarked that they had maintained a strong rapport over many years and voiced confidence that positive developments could emerge from their ongoing engagement. 

The meeting on the sidelines of the summit marks another interaction between the leaders of the two global powers, drawing international attention to potential diplomatic outcomes stemming from the discussion.

stories.title: Punjab Government Extends Section 144 and Bans Spy Devices
stories.summary:
The provincial administration in Punjab has officially prolonged the enforcement of Section 144 across the entire region for an additional thirty days. An official notification detailing the directive was issued by the Punjab Home Department.

Under the updated restrictions, the deployment of covert recording and spying apparatuses is strictly prohibited. The ban specifically targets concealed recording tools disguised as everyday items such as pens, eyeglasses, and keychains. Furthermore, the order outlaws the unauthorized capture of photographs, video filming, audio recording, and the distribution of such media, alongside forbidding physical and online retail shops from trading in these surveillance instruments.

The regulatory update explicitly exempts standard electronic items approved by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, including mobile phones, tablets, and laptop computers. Previously, the government had implemented Section 144 measures between October 6 and 15 due to apprehensions regarding public safety and the preservation of citizen lives and assets.

That earlier order prohibited public gatherings, rallies, and assemblies involving five or more individuals in open spaces, public squares, and major roadways, alongside a total ban on the public exhibition and carriage of weaponry. Inciting individuals to join unauthorized assemblies was likewise outlawed under the decree.

However, specific exemptions were carved out for marriage ceremonies, funeral rites, burials, and religious places of worship such as mosques. Judicial bodies, official government facilities, authorized public events, and security personnel performing official duties were also excused from the restrictions, which were formally authorized by the Punjab Home Secretary pursuant to Section 144(6) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

stories.title: Australian Dollar Sinks and Bonds Rally Following Weak October Jobs Report
stories.summary:
The Australian currency declined in Sydney on Thursday after a disappointing employment report for October led financial markets to abandon expectations of further monetary tightening. Instead, investors increased bets on future interest rate reductions, triggering a significant rally in government bonds to three-month highs.

Official figures revealed that the local labor market experienced a pronounced downturn, shedding positions for a second consecutive month. This pushed the unemployment rate to a five-year peak of 4.9 percent, exceeding the projections of the central bank as the cumulative effect of five rate hikes this year to 4.85 percent restricted economic demand.

Financial swaps no longer anticipate any potential tightening by the Reserve Bank of Australia, with a rate reduction now fully priced in for August and a 68 percent probability assigned to a move in June. Consequently, the Australian dollar dropped 0.5 percent to $0.6679, marking its eighth consecutive session of losses and nearing its lowest level of the year.

Bond yields dropped sharply in response to the changing monetary outlook, with three-year yields decreasing by 17 basis points to 4.612 percent and ten-year yields falling 12 basis points to 4.977 percent. George Tharenou, chief economist at UBS, noted that the central bank faces a policy dilemma because inflation remains excessively high while both the housing sector and the labor market deteriorate quickly. UBS adjusted its forecast to expect a total easing cycle of 75 basis points beginning in August 2027.

stories.title: Lenovo Reports 48 Percent Revenue Surge Driven by Strong Artificial Intelligence Sales
stories.summary:
Chinese technology firm Lenovo announced a 48 percent increase in revenue for the second quarter, outperforming analyst expectations due to robust demand for artificial intelligence-related products, notably servers and data center hardware.

Total revenue climbed to $30.2 billion, exceeding the $27.6 billion consensus estimate compiled from six analysts by LSEG. Under Hong Kong accounting standards, the company recorded a net loss of $640 million, shifting from a net profit of $340 million during the same period in the previous year.

Conversely, Lenovo reported an adjusted net profit of $1.4 billion, reflecting a 166 percent increase when calculated using alternative accounting guidelines. This adjusted figure excludes non-cash accounting elements related to warrants and convertible bonds issued as part of a strategic partnership with Alat, a manufacturing and technology entity based in Saudi Arabia.

The Infrastructure Solutions Group achieved its highest-performing quarter to date, with revenue surging 178 percent year-on-year to reach $11.3 billion. Overall artificial intelligence-related revenue grew by 79 percent to $10.8 billion, representing 36 percent of the group's aggregate revenue. Meanwhile, the division encompassing personal computers, tablets, and smartphones grew by 15 percent, accounting for approximately 60 percent of total quarterly revenue.

stories.title: Russian Military Conducts Overnight Drone Strikes Targeting Ukrainian Energy and Port Facilities
stories.summary:
The Russian defence ministry reported on Thursday that its military forces executed overnight drone attacks against energy networks and port infrastructure in Ukraine. Moscow stated that the operations were aimed at disrupting logistics and support for the Ukrainian military.

According to the ministry, the strikes successfully impacted two power substations located in the Odesa region alongside fuel storage facilities situated at the port of Chornomorsk. Additionally, the operation targeted a cargo ship that authorities alleged was transporting dual-use goods to the city of Odesa.

Russian forces also directed drone strikes toward the northeastern city of Sumy. In that location, a power substation was hit because it supplied electricity to logistical hubs and facilities linked to the Ukrainian defence industry.

The strikes are part of ongoing military actions by Russia to degrade critical infrastructure and supply chains utilized by Ukraine. The defense ministry detailed these targets in its daily update regarding the overnight operations.

stories.title: Philippines Secures $453.4 Million Through Auction of Three-Year Onshore Retail Dollar Bonds
stories.summary:
The Philippine Bureau of the Treasury successfully raised $453.4 million during an auction of three-year onshore retail dollar bonds held on Thursday. The debt issuance drew significant interest from investors seeking foreign currency-denominated government securities.

During the auction, the treasury set the coupon rate for the three-year retail dollar bonds at 5.650 percent. Total tenders submitted for the offering reached $839.5 million, allowing the government to select the optimal amount of capital to accept.

Following the auction results, the public offer period for the retail dollar bonds is scheduled to run from November 19 to November 24. This allows individual and institutional investors to purchase the securities directly through participating financial institutions.

stories.title: Pakistan Slams India's Suspension of Indus Waters Treaty at UN
stories.summary:
Pakistan has strongly condemned India's unilateral decision to place the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance, labeling the action as outlaw behavior during a UN Security Council meeting on natural resources and conflict prevention. Speaking in New York, First Secretary Ansar Shah warned that India's move violates international law, jeopardizes the water security of over 240 million Pakistanis, and threatens to escalate tensions between the two nuclear-armed neighbors.

The diplomatic clash followed statements made during an Arria-formula meeting convened by Liberia, where Deputy Permanent Representative Ambassador Usman Jadoon discussed the connection between natural resources, sustainable development, and conflict prevention. Jadoon argued that shared natural resources, particularly transboundary water systems, must be managed through peaceful dispute settlement and adherence to international agreements rather than being weaponized for political coercion.

During the exchanges, Pakistani representatives highlighted a recent August 31 award by the Court of Arbitration, which affirmed that the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty remains fully in force and that India continues to be bound by its obligations. Pakistan asserted that the treaty contains no provisions allowing either party to unilaterally suspend it, and rejected India's arguments regarding changing global conditions since its signing.

In response, India's Permanent Representative, Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni, defended existing mechanisms for managing resource disputes and pointed to successful cooperation models like the Kimberley Process. The diplomatic exchange underscored deep disagreements over the future of the river system, which allocates eastern rivers to India and western rivers to Pakistan under specified conditions.

stories.title: Ella Langley Sweeps Country Music Awards as Taylor Swift Performs
stories.summary:
Ella Langley dominated the Country Music Association awards in Nashville on Wednesday, securing six awards including the top honor of entertainer of the year. Her breakout hit "Choosin' Texas" triumphed in major categories such as single, song, and album of the year, following a historic 27-week run at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. More than 7,000 members of the Country Music Association voted to give the 27-year-old artist a sweeping victory across the gala's major categories.

The ceremony, broadcast live on ABC and streamed on Disney+, also marked Taylor Swift's first performance at the CMAs in 13 years. Swift, who began her career in country music before achieving pop stardom, performed a mashup of her nominated song "I Knew It, I Knew You" from the "Toy Story 5" soundtrack and her 2006 country hit "Our Song." Joined by Keith Urban on banjo, Swift also presented the Willie Nelson Lifetime Achievement Award to the duo Brooks & Dunn.

The evening opened with a heartfelt tribute to country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in August at the age of 80. Host Lainey Wilson honored Parton as "Tennessee's angel" and performed a duet of the ballad "I Will Always Love You" alongside Vince Gill. Wilson praised Parton for providing hope, joy, and a powerful enduring musical legacy amidst global challenges.

Langley expressed astonishment at her unprecedented success throughout the night, joking during her final acceptance speech that she was sick of herself and could quit tomorrow with the best career of her life. The event celebrated both contemporary achievements in country music and the enduring impact of genre legends before a large industry audience.

stories.title: لاہور گورنر ہاؤس میں فلاحی تنظیم کے تحت 25 جوڑوں کی اجتماعی شادی
stories.summary: لاہور کے گورنر ہاؤس میں ایک فلاحی تنظیم کے تعاون سے اجتماعی شادیوں کی ایک پروقار تقریب منعقد کی گئی جس میں 25 جوڑوں کی شادی کی گئی۔ اس تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے گورنر پنجاب سردار سلیم ہیدر خان نے کہا کہ اس طرح کے فلاحی پروگرام معاشرے کے کم وسیلہ اور غریب طبقات کے لیے امید کی ایک کرن ہیں۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی ہمیشہ سے غریبوں، مزدوروں، کسانوں اور ریڑھی بانوں کی جماعت رہی ہے اور ہمیشہ ان کے حقوق کے لیے آواز اٹھاتی رہے گی۔ سردار سلیم ہیدر خان نے مزید کہا کہ پیپلز پارٹی شہداء کی جماعت ہے اور یہ کوئی عام یا عارضی سیاسی گروپ نہیں ہے۔ تقریب کے دوران گورنر پنجاب کی جانب سے نئے رشتہ ازدواج میں منسلک ہونے والے جوڑوں کو خصوصی طور پر نقد سلامی اور جہیز کا ضروری سامان بھی تحفے میں دیا گیا۔ اس تقریب کا بنیادی مقصد غریب خاندانوں کی مالی معاونت کرنا اور انہیں باعزت طریقے سے اپنے بچوں کے فرائض سر انجام دینے میں مدد فراہم کرنا تھا۔

stories.title: پنجاب میں دفعہ 144 کے نفاذ اور پابندیوں میں تیس دن کی توسیع
stories.summary:
محکمۂ داخلہ پنجاب نے صوبے بھر میں دفعہ 144 کے تحت عائد کردہ مختلف پابندیوں میں مزید تیس روز کی توسیع کا باضابطہ نوٹیفکیشن جاری کر دیا ہے۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد سیکیورٹی خدشات کے پیش نظر صوبے میں امن و امان کی صورتحال کو برقرار رکھنا اور غیر قانونی سرگرمیوں کی روک تھام کرنا ہے۔

نئے نوٹیفکیشن کے مطابق صوبے میں خفیہ ریکارڈنگ ڈیوائسز اور جاسوسی کے لیے استعمال ہونے والے تمام آلات کے استعمال پر مکمل پابندی عائد کی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ خفیہ کیمروں والی عینکیں، قلم اور دیگر ایسی اشیاء جن میں چھپے ہوئے کیمرے موجود ہوتے ہیں، ان کی خرید و فروخت اور استعمال پر بھی پابندی کو برقرار رکھا گیا ہے۔

حکومتی احکامات کی رو سے ان خفیہ ریکارڈنگ آلات کی دکانوں اور آن لائن خرید و فروخت پر بھی سخت پابندی عائد رہے گی۔ یہ پابندیاں پورے پنجاب کے لیے اگلے تیس دنوں تک نافذ العمل ہوں گی تاکہ کسی بھی ممکنہ سیکیورٹی خطرے سے نمٹا جا سکے۔

تاہم محکمۂ داخلہ کے جاری کردہ نوٹیفکیشن میں واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ لیپ ٹاپ، ٹیبلٹس، موبائل فونز اور پاکستان ٹیلی کمیونیکیشن اتھارٹی (پی ٹی اے) سے منظور شدہ تمام ٹرمینل آلات کو اس پابندی سے مکمل طور پر مستثنیٰ قرار دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Hong Kong and China Stocks Drop to Multi-Month Lows on Tech Concerns
stories.summary:
Hong Kong and mainland Chinese stock markets plummeted to multi-month lows as intensifying trade tensions between the United States and China rattled investor confidence. Hong Kong's benchmark Hang Seng Index dropped nearly 2% by the lunch break to hit its lowest level since late June, while the Hang Seng Tech Index tumbled to a 26-month low. In China, both the CSI300 Index and the Shanghai Composite Index fell roughly 0.4%, reaching levels not seen in over a year.

The market sell-off was fueled by fears of a renewed tit-for-tat trade war spiral and expectations of potential US rate hikes that could tighten global liquidity. Investors grew increasingly anxious following Republican setbacks in US midterms, which prompted expectations of a more hawkish White House policy toward China. These concerns have been compounded by tighter US export controls on advanced artificial intelligence chips and other technologies aimed at curbing China's technological progress.

Reports indicate the Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models to reduce technological reliance. Additionally, a US House panel requested that Microsoft brief lawmakers regarding reports that the company might allow Chinese firm ByteDance to use OpenAI models via its Azure cloud platform. These developments triggered heavy losses among Hong Kong-listed AI model developers and cloud computing firms.

Among individual equities, Minimax slumped 8% to record lows, and Tencent dropped nearly 7% to over two-year lows after reporting third-quarter revenue misses and warning that new US chip restrictions could slow model training. In mainland China, technology stocks reliant on advanced semiconductors, big data, and artificial intelligence led the widespread market declines.

stories.title: Anthropic Sets New IPO Record with $1.5 Trillion Valuation Debut
stories.summary:
Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol "ANT" after pricing its initial public offering at $83 per share. This offering surpassed expectations and exceeded Elon Musk’s SpaceX, which previously raised a record $75 billion at a valuation of $1.77 trillion in June. Anthropic offered 956 million shares, raising $79.4 billion, which could increase to $89.6 billion if underwriters exercise additional purchase options. This gives the five-year-old maker of the Claude chatbot a valuation of $1.5 trillion, including employee stock options and restricted shares.

The massive public debut provides retail investors with their first direct opportunity to invest in an independent AI giant. The strong market demand comes despite recent volatility in AI stocks and investor questions regarding whether heavy technology spending will yield returns. Sentiment has also been impacted by the resignation of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang following an admission of an affair with a woman believed by US intelligence to be a Chinese spy, alongside US midterm election results giving Democrats control of Congress.

Founded in 2021 by siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei and several colleagues after leaving OpenAI, Anthropic has experienced explosive revenue growth, reaching $17 billion in the third quarter compared to $1.4 billion a year earlier. Much of this revenue originates from customers utilizing its AI models for computer coding. The company’s Claude models are recognized globally for their advanced problem-solving capabilities.

Despite the commercial success, Anthropic's IPO filing highlights the severe risks associated with advanced AI technology, warning that such systems could pose catastrophic or existential risks to society if not managed responsibly. US Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren criticized the listing on X, expressing concern over potential threats to Americans' retirements and the financial system if the IPO fails.

stories.title: امریکی، چینی اور روسی صدور کی شینزن میں تاریخی سہ فریقی ملاقات
stories.summary:
چین کے شہر شینزن میں امریکہ، چین اور روس کے سربراہان مملکت کے درمیان ایک غیرمعمولی اور تاریخی سہ فریقی ملاقات منعقد ہوئی ہے۔ امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ، چینی صدر شی جن پنگ اور روسی صدر ولادیمیر پیوٹن کے مابین ہونے والی یہ بیٹھک ایک گھنٹے سے زائد یعنی تقریباً 90 منٹ تک جاری رہی۔

ملاقات کے دوران تینوں عالمی رہنماؤں نے جوہری ہتھیاروں کے کنٹرول، ایران اور یوکرین کی جاری جنگوں، عالمی امن اور توانائی کے تحفظ جیسے اہم ترین بین الاقوامی امور پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا۔ امریکی صدر نے اس بیٹھک کو تاریخ ساز قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ تینوں ممالک جوہری ہتھیاروں کو کم کرنے کے لیے اہم کردار ادا کر سکتے ہیں۔ چینی صدر نے جوہری ہتھیاروں پر جامع پابندی اور ان کے مکمل خاتمے پر زور دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ جوہری جنگ کبھی نہیں لڑی جانی چاہیے۔

روسی صدر ولادیمیر پیوٹن نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ عالمی امن اور سلامتی برقرار رکھنا تینوں بڑی طاقتوں کی مشترکہ ذمہ داری ہے۔ مبصرین کے مطابق ٹرمپ کی توجہ ایران اور جوہری ہتھیاروں پر جبکہ پیوٹن کی توجہ یوکرین جنگ کے خاتمے پر مرکوز تھی۔ چینی صدر نے تنازعات کے حل کے لیے سفارت کاری اور باقاعدہ اعلیٰ سطحی رابطوں کی ضرورت پر زور دیا۔

ملاقات کے اختتام تک کسی بھی بڑے معاہدے یا ٹھوس پیش رفت کا باضابطہ اعلان سامنے نہیں آیا۔ بین الاقوامی امور کے ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ تینوں ممالک کے مفادات میں اختلاف کے باعث فوری اتفاق رائے ممکن نہیں، تاہم ایک میز پر بیٹھنا عالمی سفارت کاری میں ایک بڑی پیش رفت ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan and Qatar sign security agreement to tackle drug trafficking
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Qatar entered into a formal security cooperation agreement in Islamabad on Thursday. The pact features a specific action plan designed to curb drug trafficking between the two nations. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif witnessed the signing ceremony alongside Qatar's Interior Minister and Commander of the Internal Security Force, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Sheikh Khalifa signed the documents representing their respective governments during the high-level visit.

During the meetings, Prime Minister Shehbaz welcomed the visiting Qatari dignitary on his maiden trip to Pakistan and underscored the enduring ties between the two nations. The prime minister expressed gratitude to the leadership in Qatar for consistently supplying liquefied natural gas to fulfill Pakistan's energy demands. Furthermore, he noted that approximately 300,000 Pakistani expatriates reside in Qatar, actively contributing to its economic growth while highlighting potential sectors for future collaboration like trade, agriculture, IT, and mining.

In response, Sheikh Khalifa extended greetings from the Emir of Qatar and thanked Pakistani officials for their hospitality. He acknowledged Pakistan's ongoing contributions toward regional peace and stability. The visiting Qatari minister also held discussions in Rawalpindi with Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir to review mutual security challenges, counterterrorism efforts, and bilateral institutional relations.

The diplomatic engagement included several high-ranking Pakistani officials, such as Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry, and special assistants Syed Tariq Fatemi and Muhammad Zafar Iqbal. The newly signed memorandum unites Qatar's Internal Security Force, known as Lekhwiya, with Pakistan's Federal Constabulary. Both governments aim to utilize this strengthened framework to address shared regional security concerns and bolster institutional cooperation.

stories.title: ایران سے سپلائی بحال ہونے کے باوجود لاہور اور کوئٹہ میں ایل پی جی مہنگی
stories.summary:
ایران سے ایل پی جی کی سپلائی بحال ہونے کے باوجود پاکستان کے بڑے شہروں لاہور، پشاور اور کوئٹہ میں متبادل ایندھن کی قیمتوں میں کمی واقع نہیں ہو سکی ہے، جس کی وجہ سے شہریوں کو شدید پریشانی کا سامنا ہے۔ سردی کی شدت میں اضافے کے ساتھ ہی ایل پی جی عوام کی پہنچ سے دور ہوتی جا رہی ہے۔

لاہور کی مارکیٹ میں ایل پی جی کی فی کلو قیمت 500 سے 580 روپے تک مقرر ہے، جس پر شہریوں نے شدید ردعمل کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے سوال اٹھایا ہے کہ وہ اس مہنگائی میں کہاں جائیں۔ اسی طرح پشاور میں بھی قیمتوں میں ہوشربا اضافہ برقرار ہے اور مارکیٹ میں فی کلو ایل پی جی 550 سے 600 روپے تک فروخت ہو رہی ہے، جو کہ عوام کی مایوسی کا سبب بن رہا ہے۔

کوئٹہ شہر اور اس کے مضافاتی علاقوں میں بھی صورتحال مختلف نہیں ہے جہاں قیمتوں میں بڑا فرق پایا جاتا ہے۔ کوئٹہ کے وسطی علاقوں میں ایل پی جی 550 سے 580 روپے جبکہ مضافات میں 600 سے 630 روپے فی کلو تک پہنچ چکی ہے۔

واضح رہے کہ ایران سے سپلائی بحال ہونے کے بعد گزشتہ روز کراچی میں فی کلو ایل پی جی کی قیمت کم ہو کر 450 روپے پر آ گئی تھی، لیکن ملک کے دیگر حصوں میں تاحال اس سستی کا کوئی فائدہ عوام تک نہیں پہنچ سکا ہے۔

stories.title: اسرائیل نے وسطی غزہ میں فوجی آپریشن کے دوران مکانات بمباری سے اڑا دیے
stories.summary:
اسرائیل فوج نے صبح کے وقت وسطی غزہ کی پٹی میں ایک بار پھر فوجی کارروائی کرتے ہوئے فلسطینیوں کے رہائشی مکانات اور تنصیبات کو دھماکوں سے اڑا دیا ہے۔ مقامی ذرائع اور عینی شاہدین کے مطابق نصیرات مہاجر کیمپ کے شمال اور مغازی مہاجر کیمپ کے مشرق میں واقع علاقوں میں مسماری کے دوران زور دار دھماکے سنے گئے۔

ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ اسرائیلی فورسز نے مغازی کیمپ کے مشرق میں پہلے سے خالی کیے گئے متعدد مکانات کو تباہ کرنے کے لیے کواڈ کاپٹر ڈرون کے ذریعے گرائے گئے بارودی مواد کے ڈبوں کا استعمال کیا، جس کے نتیجے میں علاقے میں بڑے پیمانے پر نقصان ہوا ہے۔ اس کارروائی کے دوران علاقے میں شدید خوف و ہراس پھیل گیا۔

اسرائیلی فوج نے خود بھی باضابطہ طور پر اعلان کیا ہے کہ اس نے وسطی غزہ کی پٹی کے تین مخصوص بلاکس اور صلاح الدین روڈ کے بند حصوں میں نئے سرے سے فوجی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

اسرائیلی فوج کے علاقوں میں حکومتی سرگرمیوں کے کوآرڈینیٹر نے سوشل میڈیا پر جاری بیان میں تصدیق کی ہے کہ فوج نے وسطی غزہ میں پیلی لکیر کے قریب واقع خاص علاقوں بالخصوص بلاک 660، 661 اور 666 میں فوجی آپریشن شروع کر دیا ہے، جو جنگ بندی کی مسلسل خلافورزی کی ایک اور کڑی ہے۔

stories.title: عالمی اور مقامی صرافہ مارکیٹوں میں سونے اور چاندی کی قیمتوں میں بڑی کمی
stories.summary:
جمعرات کے روز عالمی صرافہ مارکیٹ میں فی اونس سونے کی قیمت میں 37 ڈالر کی کمی واقع ہوئی، جس کے بعد نئی قیمت 3 ہزار 727 ڈالر فی اونس ہو گئی۔ اس بین الاقوامی تنزل کا براہ راست اثر ملکی مارکیٹوں پر بھی پڑا، جہاں صرافہ مارکیٹوں میں فی تولہ سونے کی قیمت میں 3 ہزار 700 روپے کی نمایاں کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی اور یہ 3 لاکھ 95 ہزار 236 روپے پر آ گیا۔ اسی طرح، فی 10 گرام سونے کی قیمت میں بھی 3 ہزار 172 روپے کی کمی دیکھی گئی، جس کے نتیجے میں فی 10 گرام سونا 3 لاکھ 38 ہزار 851 روپے کی سطح پر فروخت ہونے لگا۔

سونے کے ساتھ ساتھ قیمتی دھات چاندی کی قیمتوں میں بھی کمی کا رجحان برقرار رہا۔ عالمی بلین مارکیٹ میں فی اونس چاندی کی قیمت 43 سینٹس گھٹ کر 45 ڈالر اور 27 سینٹس پر بند ہوئی۔ بین الاقوامی مارکیٹ میں اس کمی کے اثرات مقامی منڈیوں پر بھی مرتب ہوئے، جس کے باعث مقامی صرافہ بازاروں میں فی تولہ چاندی کی قیمت 43 روپے کم ہو کر 5 ہزار اور 5 روپے ہو گئی۔ اس کے علاوہ فی 10 گرام چاندی کی قیمت میں 37 روپے کی کمی ہوئی، جس کے بعد اس کی نئی قیمت 4 ہزار 290 روپے ریکارڈ کی گئی۔ قیمتوں میں اس مسلسل کمی کو دونوں قیمتی دھاتوں کے خریداروں کے لیے اہم قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: US President Trump Meets Putin in China Ahead of Trilateral Summit with Xi
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin met for bilateral talks in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday, preceding a scheduled three-way discussion with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Greeting Putin as his "friend," Trump stated during the meeting that they share a long-standing relationship and expressed optimism about potential outcomes. The three leaders had earlier posed for a group photograph alongside other Asia-Pacific leaders attending the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.

The high-stakes trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa takes place as Russia's offensive in Ukraine approaches its five-year mark. The discussions have sparked global concern that the major powers might attempt to dictate geopolitical outcomes, such as the fate of Ukraine, independently of Kyiv and European nations. Additional agenda items for the US delegation include the ongoing war in Iran, which has disrupted global oil supplies, and global nuclear disarmament following the recent expiration of a bilateral US-Russia atomic weapons treaty.

Ahead of the multi-way talks, President Xi broke decades of protocol by greeting Trump directly at the airport with a red-carpet welcome, an embrace, and an air-force flyover, reciprocating a similar gesture previously made by Trump in the United States. Other prominent figures participating in the APEC summit include Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, South Korean leader Lee Jae Myung, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum.

The diplomatic gathering has drawn mixed reactions internationally, with critics warning that the optics could benefit the political standings of Xi and Putin. Russian political analyst Konstantin Kalachev noted that the meeting would be framed in Russia as proof of its central global standing. Meanwhile, Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer asserted that the Chinese and Russian leaders were manipulating the US president.

stories.title: PlayStation Network Experiences Brief Outage Ahead of GTA 6 Release
stories.summary:
PlayStation users encountered sudden service disruptions on Wednesday afternoon, just hours before the highly anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto 6. The tracking website Downdetector recorded hundreds of user reports, while online screenshots from PlayStation account management and Axios confirmed that some services were facing operational issues. The disruption caused immediate anxiety among players, as GTA 6 stands as the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history and was scheduled to launch at midnight on Thursday.

The timing of the server issues amplified player concerns, given the immense volume of gamers preparing to download the title simultaneously for the PlayStation 5 and Microsoft Xbox consoles. Social media platforms quickly filled with panicked reactions, with users expressing fears of riots or extended server downtime, drawing unfavorable comparisons to recent widespread technological outages affecting air travel, banking systems, and email services.

In response to the impending launch, Sony Interactive previously issued a mandatory system software update for PlayStation 5 users, instructing players to complete the installation before November 19 to ensure uninterrupted gameplay. It remains unclear whether incomplete software updates contributed to the user complaints and service hiccups reported on Wednesday afternoon.

stories.title: پورٹ قاسم پر ایل پی جی کی اب تک کی سب سے بڑی کھیپ کی ہینڈلنگ
stories.summary:
کراچی کے پورٹ قاسم پر ایل پی جی کی ترسیل کے حوالے سے ایک اہم پیش رفت سامنے آئی ہے جہاں ای وی ٹی ایل پر ایک جہاز کے ذریعے ملک کی تاریخ کی سب سے بڑی ایل پی جی کی کھیپ کی ہینڈلنگ کی گئی ہے۔ پورٹ قاسم کے ترجمان کے مطابق، برتھ ہونے والے ایل پی جی کیریئر جہاز کا نام پیسیفک اسٹار ون ہے، جس پر 21 ہزار 115 میٹرک ٹن ایل پی جی موجود تھی۔ یہ کھیپ اس سے پہلے پورٹ قاسم پر ہینڈل کی جانے والی تمام کھیپوں میں سب سے بڑی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ، پورٹ قاسم کے آؤٹر انکریج پر ایک اور بڑا ایل پی جی کیریئر جہاز بھی موجود ہے جس کا نام سی شائن ہے۔ ترجمان کے مطابق جہاز سی شائن اس سے بھی بڑی مقدار میں ایل پی جی لے کر کھڑا ہے، جس میں 21 ہزار 866 میٹرک ٹن ایل پی جی کی کھیپ موجود ہے۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ ان بڑی کھیپوں کی آمد سے ملک میں ایل پی جی کی مجموعی سپلائی میں نمایاں بہتری آنے کی توقع ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Rebounds With KSE-100 Gaining Nearly 1,200 Points
stories.summary:
Buying interest returned to the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) on Thursday, driving the benchmark KSE-100 Index up by nearly 1,200 points during the opening minutes of trading. By 10:30 am, the index hovered at 177,485.52 points, representing an increase of 1,191.19 points or 0.68%. This positive movement followed a previous session decline, marking a recovery across several major market sectors.

Strong buying activity was observed across multiple key sectors, including automobile assemblers, cement producers, commercial banks, oil and gas exploration companies, oil marketing companies, power generation firms, and refineries. Index-heavy stocks such as ARL, HUBCO, MARI, OGDC, PPL, POL, HBL, MEBL, NBP, and UBL all traded in positive territory. The rebound contrasted with the previous day's performance, when persistent profit-taking and investor caution caused the KSE-100 Index to drop 1,223.41 points to close at 176,294.33 points.

Internationally, Asian equities and US stock futures also advanced on Thursday, supported by Claude chatbot developer Anthropic's record-breaking initial public offering. Japan's Nikkei index rose 1%, while Nasdaq futures gained 1% and S&P futures increased by 0.6%. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI pioneer at approximately $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

Despite the positive market openings, global investor sentiment regarding artificial intelligence remained fragile due to worries over profitability and infrastructure debt. Markets largely overlooked strong forecasts from chipmaker Nvidia, remaining unsettled by the recent departure of CEO Jensen Huang. Consequently, broader regional indexes saw mixed results, with MSCI's Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan declining by 0.3%.

stories.title: Katseye Member Yoonchae's Distress in Seattle Raises Fan Health Concerns
stories.summary:
Fans of the global girl group Katseye have raised serious health concerns for 18-year-old member Yoonchae Jeung. The worries emerged after videos from the group's WILDWORLD Tour performance in Seattle on November 17 showed the young artist visibly distressed. Footage shared across social media platforms captured Yoonchae sniffling, wiping her face, and apparently trying to hold back tears while on stage.

Additional reports from concert attendees suggested that Yoonchae temporarily stepped away during a specific suit-and-tie segment while her fellow members continued interacting with the audience. Neither Yoonchae nor the group's management has issued a statement confirming the reason behind her emotional state. The incident provoked immediate reactions online, with supporters questioning the group's demanding touring schedule and expressing sympathy for the singer's wellbeing.

This concern follows a series of recent medical interruptions for the six-member ensemble, which was formed through a collaboration between HYBE and Geffen Records on The Debut: Dream Academy. Member Manon Bannerman took a hiatus in February 2026 to focus on her health, and group leader Sophia Laforteza started an extended break in August with a planned return in January 2027. Additionally, Megan Skiendiel suffered a concussion that forced the postponement of concerts in Detroit, Chicago, and Minneapolis before she returned at an Austin show largely seated and wearing dark sunglasses.

With only four members—Daniela Avanzini, Lara Raj, Megan, and Yoonchae—currently active on stage, supporters are increasingly vocal about reevaluating the group's workload. The ongoing health setbacks have amplified debates among fans regarding the physical and emotional toll placed on the young performers during their international concert commitments.

stories.title: Pakistan and Maldives Form Joint Working Group to Boost Maritime Trade
stories.summary:
Pakistan and the Maldives have agreed to establish a Joint Working Group (JWG) aimed at increasing bilateral trade to $200 million within two years. The initiative also focuses on enhancing port connectivity, institutional collaboration, and maritime cooperation, with a particular emphasis on exploring investments in the blue economy. 

The decision was finalized during a high-level virtual meeting between Pakistan's Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Anwar Chaudhry and the Maldives Minister for Economic Development, Transport and Trade Mohamed Saeed. Other notable attendees from the Pakistani side included Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan and Prime Minister's Adviser on Industries and Production Haroon Akhtar Khan. 

Pakistan plans to diversify its export basket to the island nation by increasing shipments of rice, sugar, fruits, vegetables, pharmaceuticals, and textiles. The newly formed JWG will consist of representatives from relevant economic sectors and institutions in both countries to identify trade opportunities, evaluate areas of cooperation, and develop proposals that facilitate commerce and investment. 

Both nations underscored the importance of efficient port-to-port connections and stronger institutional coordination to encourage business-to-business engagement. As a follow-up measure, a delegation representing various Pakistani economic and industrial sectors, led by Minister Junaid Chaudhry, is scheduled to visit the Maldives soon to explore practical cooperation and trade opportunities.

stories.title: US Federal Judge Blocks Directives Restricting International Student Internships
stories.summary:
A federal judge in Boston has blocked the U.S. Department of Homeland Security from enforcing directives that restricted practical training and internship opportunities for international university students on visas. U.S. District Judge Julia Kobick issued an injunction in a lawsuit filed by organizations including the Association of American Universities and the Presidents’ Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration. 

The legal challenge targeted two August directives issued by DHS—which oversees U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement—that abruptly altered rules governing curricular practical training (CPT). Higher education groups argued that the agency sharply narrowed a program that had allowed foreign students to participate in school-authorized internships directly related to their field of study for over 35 years. 

The contested DHS directives stated that internships would only qualify if they were mandatory for every student in a degree program, excluding elective training taken for academic credit. The agency reported a rise in CPT authorizations that it claimed failed to meet program requirements. In 2024, approximately 140,775 student visa holders participated in CPT, with Amazon and Tesla acting as the top two employers. 

Judge Kobick, an appointee of former Democratic President Joe Biden, ruled that the government's directives were likely arbitrary and capricious under the Administrative Procedure Act. She noted that DHS failed to acknowledge it was making a fundamental shift from its longstanding interpretation of the program's rules.

stories.title: Pakistan Urges Realistic UN Peacekeeping Mandates and Global Cooperation
stories.summary:
Pakistan has reaffirmed its dedication to international security and peace, pointing to its seven decades of contributions to United Nations peacekeeping missions. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif shared these remarks on Wednesday while addressing the Schuman Security and Defence Forum at the European Parliament located in Brussels.

Asif noted that 237,000 Pakistani personnel have participated in 48 UN peacekeeping operations over the last seven decades, with 183 peacekeepers losing their lives. He emphasized that cooperative security policies are vital, warning that abrupt cuts to UN missions in conflict regions could worsen human security threats. Furthermore, he argued that peacekeeping mandates must be realistic, adequately funded, and tied to sustainable political solutions, while troop-contributing nations should have a meaningful voice in shaping these frameworks.

Highlighting human security as a central pillar, Asif stated that peace requires sustainable stability rather than merely the absence of war. He pointed out that economic vulnerabilities, food insecurity, and climate change drive global conflicts, noting that Pakistan suffers directly from climate risks. He also called for resolving longstanding disputes through international law and UN resolutions, alongside ensuring unimpeded humanitarian aid and fulfilling commitments to development and climate action.

Reiterating support for multilateralism, Asif expressed Pakistan's readiness to act as a bridge for a more inclusive and effective international system. He concluded that the country will persistently support sustainable peace, human dignity, and global justice.

stories.title: Finance Minister Aurangzeb Promotes Pakistan Investment Opportunities in Singapore
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb called on Pakistani businesspeople in Singapore to actively promote Pakistan as a prime investment destination. Speaking at a dinner hosted by Pakistan's High Commissioner to Singapore, Rabia Shafiq, at Pakistan House, Aurangzeb highlighted the country's advancing macroeconomic stability and ongoing government reforms aimed at lowering the fiscal deficit.

Recalling his own time spent in Singapore, the finance minister praised the overseas Pakistani diaspora as a vital national asset and key partner in national economic development. He encouraged business community members to help foster stronger commercial ties and engagement between Pakistani entities and investors in Singapore.

Aurangzeb detailed various investment sectors available in Pakistan and spotlighted the government's privatisation programme. He explained that privatizing state-owned enterprises is intended to reduce the financial strain on the national exchequer, curb government expenditures, and boost overall economic efficiency.

During the interaction, members of the local Pakistani business community shared their views on enhancing Pakistan's appeal to foreign investors. They also discussed avenues for deepening business-to-business engagement and put forward various proposals to encourage investment and economic cooperation.

stories.title: پاکستان نے بھارتی طیاروں کے لیے فضائی حدود کی بندش میں مزید ایک ماہ توسیع کر دی
stories.summary:
پاکستان نے بھارت کے لیے اپنی فضائی حدود کی بندش میں مزید ایک ماہ کی توسیع کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس تازہ فیصلے کے تحت اب بھارتی طیاروں کے لیے فضائی حدود کی بندش کی مدت میں 23 دسمبر 2026 تک توسیع کر دی گئی ہے۔ اس حوالے سے پاکستان ایئرپورٹ اتھارٹی (پی اے اے) نے ایک نیا نوٹم جاری کر دیا ہے جس میں اس توسیع کا باضابطہ اعلان کیا گیا ہے۔

جاری کردہ نوٹم کے مطابق بھارت کے تمام رجسٹرڈ کمرشل طیارے، جیٹ مسافر طیارے اور ملٹری طیارے پاکستان کی فضائی حدود کا استعمال نہیں کر سکیں گے۔ واضح رہے کہ پاکستان نے بھارت کے لیے یہ پابندی پہلی بار 23 اپریل 2025 کو عائد کی تھی، جس کے بعد سے پاکستانی فضائی حدود بھارتی طیاروں کے لیے مسلسل بند چلی آ رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Elon Musk Expresses Regret Over Heavy Spending on Failed US Elections
stories.summary:
Billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk stated via videolink at the New York Times Dealbook conference that he felt foolish for donating nearly half a billion dollars to failed campaigns in recent U.S. midterm elections. Musk backed right-wing Republicans in races that were largely won by Democrats, noting that his actual goal was for either the presidency, the House, or the Senate to be controlled by the opposing party.

The Tesla and SpaceX chief executive reflected on the outcome by emphasizing that American elections cannot be bought with money alone, admitting that significant financial input can yield a relatively minor electoral effect. He remarked that if he could rewind the clock, he would have spent less money on the campaigns, attributing his limited personal attention to his primary focus on building Tesla and SpaceX.

This follows previous heavy political spending by the South Africa-born tech tycoon, who contributed over $250 million to help Donald Trump secure his second term and briefly led the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) before a brief falling out. Following a reconciliation, Musk has continued supporting Trump-backed Republicans, including an estimated $220 million contribution to Texas Senate candidate Ken Paxton, who ultimately lost the race to Democratic challenger James Talarico.

stories.title: PSX Extends Recovery as Fertilizer and Energy Stocks Offset Losses
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange recorded a positive trading session on Wednesday, extending its ongoing recovery despite underlying market volatility. The benchmark KSE-100 Index climbed approximately 480 points to close above the 176,770 threshold. Market activity was supported by value buying in key fertilizer and energy stocks, which successfully offset profit-taking and investor caution driven by domestic political tensions and geopolitical uncertainties.

The trading day began on a strong footing, with the KSE-100 Index reaching an intraday high of 177,930, marking a gain of 1,635 points or 0.93%. However, profit-taking during the latter half of the session reduced those early gains, pulling the index down to an intraday low of 176,597 before stabilization occurred. According to Arif Habib Ltd Deputy Head of Trading Ali Najib, the market found defensive support from lower-level value buying following a recent decline to a weekly low of 176,054.

Major positive contributors to the index included ENGROH, EFERT, FFC, MARI, and SYS, which collectively added roughly 603 points to the benchmark. Conversely, profit-taking weighed on major laggards such as UBL, PSEL, AICL, ATRL, and HBL, which cumulatively eroded 181 points from the index. Overall trading volume reached 723 million shares with a total traded value exceeding Rs21.1 billion, led heavily by Worldcall Telecom (WTL) with over 141 million shares traded.

Analysts indicate that the KSE-100 Index may sustain a cautious recovery path backed by bargain hunting and improving industrial performance. Nevertheless, ongoing domestic political instability and wider geopolitical tensions are expected to maintain elevated levels of market volatility. Consequently, selective equity investments in fundamentally resilient fertilizer and energy sectors remain the preferred approach for market participants.

stories.title: Bangladesh Boosts Security and Deploys Paramilitary Troops Amid Political Unrest
stories.summary:
Bangladesh increased security and deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops nationwide as violent clashes, bomb blasts, and arson attacks erupted ahead of the planned December return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Hasina, who has lived in exile in India since fleeing violent protests in August 2024, recently requested a new passport and identity card. The government has rejected her request, prompting members of her banned Awami League party to launch protests and a week-long mobilization culminating in a nationwide lockdown on November 19.

Over the past ten days, authorities have recorded crude bomb blasts and torched vehicles across at least 28 districts, injuring several police personnel and civilians. The unrest coincides with the one-year anniversary of a local court sentencing Hasina to death for ordering a deadly crackdown on the 2024 student-led uprising. Incidents of violence include a petrol bomb attack that killed a ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party activist in Gopalganj, a bus helper burnt to death in Pirojpur, and explosions near the Dhaka residence of Cultural Affairs Minister Nitai Roy Chowdhury.

The ruling government has blamed the Awami League for the surge in violence, which has also targeted at least 37 branches of Grameen Bank, founded by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus. In response, Dhaka Metropolitan Police arrested 71 members of banned organizations within a 24-hour period. The security measures and troop deployments aim to curb further escalations as political tensions remain severely heightened across the country.

stories.title: Israeli Parliament Selects New Speaker as Opposition Initiates Legislative Push
stories.summary:
Israel’s parliament convened under a newly elected speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc, marking the beginning of a legislative effort by opposition figures to roll back the caretaker prime minister's legacy. Lawmakers voted 66 to 120 in favor of Matan Kahana, an ally of Yashar party leader and former military chief Gadi Eisenkot.
